author: Flebula
body:
So I was just thinking of a new game mode that Avicus could have. I haven't named it yet but maybe you guys could name suggestions. So, the game is like a mixture of nebula, nexus and walls but in one game xD.

So, like the walls, two teams start in a section with a wall divided between them but hey have the exact same biome and materials as each other. Each team starts with a diamond pickaxe and 20 pieces of bread and that is all. like walls both teams have to collect their materials to PvP once the walls drop each team has to find one block of obsidian that has been hidden somewhere. It can be anywhere on the map and both teams have to PvP and build tunnels to find the obsidian. Once you die you are out of the game. the numbers of people will slowly decrease and there will be less people to find the obsidian which is hidden. Whoever gets the obsidian first wins. There is a time limit of 20 minutes. Whoever wins gets one point. First team to get to five points (Five wins) wins the 5 game series.

Rules:
You can PvP
You can build and dig
No fire
And basic rules that no avicus game will tolerate

Also, you can get kits so you start with more tools and food.
